notes.title: Logic - Keypad participates in Steam Puzzle Fest
notes.content:
[i]Dear Gamers,[/i]

I am excited to announce that my game [b]Logic - Keypad[/b] will be participating in the upcoming [b]Steam Puzzle Fest[/b] event on April 24th! To celebrate this special occasion, I am offering a massive 35% discount on Keypad during the event.

If you love brain-teasing puzzles and challenging gameplay, don't miss out on this opportunity to grab [b]Logic - Keypad[/b] at a discounted price. Join the event [b]Steam Puzzle Fest[/b] and immerse yourself in the headache with [b]Logic - Keypad[/b], where your stress and inhibitions will be challenged to the next level. new high.

Mark your calendars for [b]April 24th[/b] and get ready to challenge your mind with [b]Logic - Keypad[/b]. See you at [b]Steam Puzzle Fest![/b]

[i]Sincerely,[/i]

notes.title: Update version 1.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated to fix some bugs, add some things, and some other things that I can't remember.
[*] This is just a small update to make the game more user-friendly and enjoyable.
[/list] 
[b]Logic - Keypad[/b] will also participate in the upcoming Steam Fuzzle Fest promotion from April 24th to May 1st, so you can expect a better discount then.

notes.title: Game Release
notes.content:
[h3]The game has ended its Early Access and will be released in the full version on March 11th[/h3]
[list]
[*] All levels, puzzles, codes, and hints have been fully and meticulously updated and completed in the game.
[*] Optimized performance for PC, fixed any image and sound conflicts, and improved loading times for each level.
Players can enable all settings in Ultra mode for the best experience.
[*] The game price will remain the same after the end of the Early Access phase.
You can purchase the game at any time or wishlist and wait for upcoming discounts.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425014/df5bd3213c8f6fcb4a072c199d9387bf68c043fc.png[/img]

[i]Thank you very much to the players who have accompanied the game during the Early Access phase.[/i]

notes.title: Updated more Hints for the game
notes.content:
[h1]Updated more Hints for the game[/h1]

[h2]Fixed some interface and image issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Optimized the game better for low-end machines, you can turn on Ultra for higher quality graphics.
[*] The game has been updated with many more Hints so that everyone can play, the difficulty of the puzzles remains the same if the player does not view the Hints.
[*] Hints are now simpler, easier to understand, and some may reveal the answers.
[*] Players can use Hints unlimitedly, but if you want to experience the perfect game, please consider it.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425014/40884ea17588346e4316676ed0877d0f0bbb6110.png[/img]

[i]This update does not apply to the Demo version, so the difficulty level of the Demo version will remain high even if Hints are used.[/i]

notes.title: Game release - 24/2
notes.content:
[b]Game is scheduled to launch on February 24th[/b]

Although in the Early Access stage, the game is almost complete and players can fully experience it.
I will maintain this for a short period of time to update, modify, and add new ideas (if any).

This is my first game on Steam, and I hope you enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425014/6b8c85cc0c6900490d46e44b3465bdd08ba04fb7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Deactivate Demo version
notes.content:
Deactivate Demo version. The Demo has done its job well when it comes to player feedback and reviews.
To focus on game development, the Demo will be paused to make further improvements as the development process has changed significantly from the original plan.

Updated a few images and game introduction videos with the story written in 30 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425014/cec556aa5e4d7f40c7381db80841841b178173ac.png[/img]
